title: fix(cli): os serve refuses to boot when a plugins entry that may provide the crypto provider does not load
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X1zG3Xn4JonaKvDLLr5gnjL)_

Refs #28284

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：`os serve` 启动时，若栈的 `plugins` 里某一项没能加载，且无法根据它的声明排除它是加密提供者(`crypto-provider`)，则拒绝启动，并在报错里点名该项(`plugins[i] ('<名称或包名>')`)与加载失败原因。已加载出插件对象(或本身是对象)、但其 `providesServices` 未列出 `crypto-provider`(包括没有 `providesServices`)的项不受影响：照旧打印 `✗ Failed to load plugin` 后继续启动。
- **为什么改**：QA 第三轮发现的安全加固(细节按披露裁决不公开)
- **风险与回滚**：只改 `@objectstack/cli`(patch)。所有插件都能加载的启动不受影响。会被新拒绝的只有：包名无法导入的项，以及声明自己提供 `crypto-provider` 却加载失败的项。规则与一次性 secret 命令对同一 host 配置的规则一致。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts` 的 `refuseUnloadedCryptoProviderPlugins`，以及 `run()` 里栈插件循环之后、`createHostCryptoProvider` 之前的那一次调用。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit src/commands/serve-host-crypto-provider.test.ts`，预期全部通过。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位做 contract review 后落地。

## What changes

- **`os serve` refuses to boot when a `plugins` entry that may provide the crypto provider does not load.** The provider (`crypto-provider`) seals every secret field, datasource credential and encrypted setting, and the host chooses it once, so a boot without it does not choose another one. The check runs right after the stack's plugins are loaded and before the host's crypto provider is built, in every posture (`plugins`, and `devPlugins` under `--dev`). The refusal names each entry and the reason it did not load.
  - An entry that never materialized (a package specifier that does not resolve or import) declares nothing, so it is refused.
  - An entry that materialized (or is itself an object) and declares `providesServices: ['crypto-provider']` (ADR-0116) is refused.
  - An entry that materialized (or is itself an object) and does not name the crypto provider in `providesServices`, including one that declares no `providesServices`, is ruled out: it is printed with `✗ Failed to load plugin`, and the boot goes on without it, as before.
- **New export** `refuseUnloadedCryptoProviderPlugins` (and its input type `UnloadedStackPlugin`) beside `refuseTwoCryptoProviderPlugins` in `commands/serve.ts`. It throws the existing `HostCryptoProviderRefusal`.
- This is the rule the one-shot secret commands keep for the same host config.

Nothing a stack can declare changes; a boot in which every entry loads is unchanged.

## Why

QA 第三轮发现的安全加固(细节按披露裁决不公开)

## Verification

Every reading below is on head `5ed7975ab` (one commit on `main` at `d3f36861e`) unless it says otherwise.

<details><summary>Pins, red-first and restore</summary>

- New `packages/cli/test/serve-crypto-provider-plugin-load-failure.integration.test.ts`: four real `os serve` boots (src, through the `runServe` helper), one cause each. Two are refused and name the entry and `crypto-provider`: an instance declaring `providesServices: ['crypto-provider']` that the kernel does not accept, and a package specifier that does not import. Two CONTROLs reach the ready banner on a bound port: an entry declaring another service that the kernel does not accept, and a stack whose every entry loads.
- `packages/cli/src/commands/serve-host-crypto-provider.test.ts`: five unit cases for `refuseUnloadedCryptoProviderPlugins` (never materialized, materialized and declaring, an object entry, a ruled-out CONTROL, several named in one refusal), plus a source pin that the record sits in the plugin loop and the check sits between the loop and `createHostCryptoProvider`.
- Red-first, on the pre-rebase commit: with `serve.ts` set back to its `main` blob, the integration file read 2 failed | 2 passed (4), the two refusal cases red and the two CONTROLs green. Restored: blob equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty, 4 passed (4). The CLI runs from `src` here, so no rebuild sits between mutation and run.

</details>
